record.title: Follow stock initialization to its next unsupported access
record.intent: Discover the next actual environment dependency after the established two-word identity input.
requirements: Use the controlled native executable, pinned fresh guest and byte-identical stock artifacts.
Retain exactly the existing two synthetic words, thread coverage and original open/mmap evidence.
Run continuously after the second response without a post-store breakpoint.
Capture the first unsupported mapped access on any covered thread without supplying another value.
Distinguish another process fault, signal, exit or observation-bound exhaustion from a mapped-device dependency.
Account for runtime thread events, terminal pending stops and cleanup; preserve all partial evidence if the observer fails.
acceptance: Report the reached boundary with its instruction, thread and state evidence, or an explicit reproducible negative.
No physical instrument access, stock artifact modification or new register response.
